newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz says relaxed on UAP/Axa merger.
newsitem.headline: Allianz says relaxed on UAP/Axa merger.

text.p: German insurance giant Allianz AG Holding took a relaxed line on merger plans announced Tuesday by French insurers Union Assurances de Paris (UAP) and Axa.
"We congratulate them on the wedding," an Allianz spokesman told Reuters, declining further comment.
The French merger will create an insurance giant that will rob Allianz of its position as the biggest European insurance company.
Industry sources said the merger news would concern all European insurers active in the markets in which the merged group would play a leading role.
Axa chairman Claude Bebear said the new group would take leading positions in the U.K., Belgium, Germany and Spain.
UAP is the majority owner of Colonia AG, one of Germany's leading insurance companies.
